changes.item: the per-function colour-matrix payload with the [0,1] clamp between functions
changes.files: reference/native/shaders/filters.rs (ColorMatrixUniforms: 8 ColorMatrixEntry slots + count; blur_composite_color loops with saturate between), reference/native/src/scene.rs (GpuiGoSceneFilterRecord 188 to 780 bytes; MAX_SCENE_FILTERS 8; check_filter validates the slots), reference/native/src/renderer/draw.rs (CompositeExtensionsUniforms 112 to 656 bytes), gpui/filter_colors.go (FilterChain carries the per-function matrices), gpui/scene.go + gpui/scene_kernel.go + internal/native/scene.go + scene_batch.go (the mirrors)
changes.rule: Chrome does NOT compose a filter chain into one linear map: each function's output is rasterized 8-bit before the next applies, clamping every channel to [0,1]. Measured against the filters-chain Chrome record (hue-rotate(90deg) sepia(1)): pure red reads (70,62,48) = sepia*clamp(hue*red) while the composed matrix gives (42,38,29); pure green (216,192,150) = sepia*clamp(hue*green) vs composed (236,211,164); pure blue (107,95,74) vs composed (66,58,45); white and gray are clamp-invariant. All 15 recorded channel values match the clamp-after-each model exactly
changes.measured: with the uniform fix alone (the composed rev-15 payload), the filters-chain fixture measured whole 0.3510 / hot 0.00450 and the hue-sepia ROI 15.4667 / 0.20000 (the arithmetic prediction of the clamp difference: (23.8+17.6+35.7)/5 = 15.4 mean over the five stripes). With the per-function payload: whole 0.0000 / hot 0.00000, both chain ROIs 0.0000 - pixel-exact
changes.recorded_approximations: a chain longer than the record's capacity (8 entries minus the composed blur) composes its excess into the last slot, and a blur interleaved between colour functions still composes with the other blurs (gaussians commute; the clamp between a blur and a matrix does not) - both documented in the record's doc and shaders/mod.rs divergence 3
changes.gate: internal/parity fixtures filters-colors / filters-chain / filters-image (Tier C now active, tolerances at 2x the measured stats), internal/scenespec TestColorMatrixFilterRecordRoundTrips and TestColorMatrixFilterValidationRejectsMalformedRecords (the new beyond-the-count slot rule), gpui TestFilterBoundaryCarriesComposedChain / TestComposeFilterChain (the per-function slots)

changes.files: reference/native/src/glyph.rs (synthetic_italic_shear / SYNTHETIC_ITALIC_SHEAR / raster_transform(scale, shear); NativeFace::new no longer sets DWRITE_FONT_SIMULATIONS_OBLIQUE; create_glyph_analysis / rasterize_mask / rasterize_colr carry the shear)
changes.rule: Chrome shears a family without an italic face by exactly -0.25 (Skia setSkewX(-SK_Scalar1/4), platform/fonts/win/font_platform_data_win.cc:37-38, Chromium 0d4dcd4f) - raster-only (advances come from the upright face). The shear rides the raster transform (m21 = shear * scale, pivoting on the glyph-run baseline), driven by Fontique's synthesis FLAG only: the constant is Chrome's 1/4, not Fontique's 14 degrees (tan 14 = 0.2493). The DWrite oblique simulation (measured -0.3399, 34% steeper) is gone; the bold simulation is untouched (rev 15's measured-good rule)
changes.invariants: shaping, advances and the glyph-cache keys are unchanged (the FontId already carries the synthesis; Chrome's faux italic does not move metrics); the subpixel baseline origin is unaffected (the shear pivots on the baseline); all three raster paths (mask, monochrome color, COLRv0) share the transform; real italic faces never hit the synthesis flag (the segoe-italic control measures Chrome-identical before and after)
changes.measured: the 08 italic probe: gpui tahoma-italic shear -0.3399 (rev 15) to -0.2500 (rev 15.1) vs Chrome's -0.2500; dx over the stems 16.3 to 12.0 px (Chrome 12.0). The textpaint-italic Tier C: whole 0.3460 to 0.2165, hot 0.00494 to 0.00328, worst ROI (tahoma-italic) 1.7671 to 0.6882 - toward Chrome, exactly as the 08 README predicted; the fixture tolerance re-recorded at 2x the new stats (0.45 / 1.4 / 0.02, the wrong-view M-stem discriminator still fails at whole 1.573 / ROI 5.918)
changes.gate: research/browser-parity/08-raster-probes TestItalicSlant (now asserts the shear: the synthetic row -0.25 on both sides, the controls 0 and Chrome-identical), internal/parity TestFixtures/textpaint-italic, the re-measured captures textpaint-italic{,-4x}.png

changes.item: text-wrap: nowrap drives the wrap policy (the one wireable rev-15 text-run field)
changes.files: reference/native/src/text.rs (nowrap_requested; text_shape_body and text_layout_body suppress the wrap constraint; TEXT_WRAP_NOWRAP)
changes.rule: CSS text-wrap is a wrap policy and the pinned TextLayoutRequest CAN express 'do not soft-wrap' (wrap_width: None -> the adapter's break_all_lines(None), the pinned hard-break-only path). When any run carries the tag, text_shape and text_layout pass None; the layout summary reports the ACTIVE constraint (no wrap) while text_run_info still echoes the tag; hard breaks and the line clamp are unaffected; document-level by necessity (one wrap constraint per request)
changes.blocked_fields: recorded per field in reference/native/TEXT_ABI.md with file:line, the smallest plan and an estimate: word-break and overflow-wrap (Parley 0.11.1 has StyleProperty::WordBreak/OverflowWrap and the builder hook, but both live behind gpui_ce_parley's private parley state and the pinned TextRun has no slot; needs the vendored adapter patch, 6-10 h), locale (no slot; Parley has no language style; upstream change first), font width / variations / optical size (the pinned resolve hardcodes FontWidth::NORMAL at catalog.rs and the store's variation interning is pub(crate); vendored adapter with an extended resolve entry, 6-10 h), justify (the pinned TextAlign is Left/Center/Right only and Parley's Alignment::Justify is unreachable; 4-6 h), balance/pretty/stable (Go-side bisection by the rev-15 record's design), and the layout baseline (Taffy 0.13's leaf compute hardcodes first_baselines: Point::NONE - LAYOUT_ABI.md's recorded limit, revisit with R17)
changes.gate: internal/textspec rev15_1_nowrap_test.go (TestTextWrapNoWrapSuppressesSoftWrap: the control wraps to 3 rows, nowrap stays 1 row with no active wrap in the summary, relayout stays 1 row, balance/pretty/stable still wrap; TestTextWrapNoWrapKeepsHardBreaks: newlines survive, the clamp applies)
